title: Deep learning guides higher-activity SpuFz1 nuclease variants
summary: A DeepSequence-based predictor ranked SpuFz1 mutations without experimental activity labels; experimentally confirmed substitutions were combined into SpuFz1-v3. At the B2M locus in HEK293T cells, the article reports 35.52% indel formation versus 3.07% for wild type. Comparative sequence analysis, not this AI model, guided the separate ultrashort RNA design. The reported activity is assay- and locus-specific; off-target and clinical safety are not established.

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific measured result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and clinical or industrial efficacy are not established.
evidence.ai_role: A learned sequence fitness predictor ranks candidate mutations; researchers assay single substitutions and combine successful variants.

source_review.scope: Primary publisher full indexed article, results and methods
